---
title: "Boxplots and violins"
description: "Two views of the same grouped distribution: a boxplot and a violin, side by side."
categories: [Statistical]
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_helper.R")
```

`mark_boxplot()` and `mark_violin()` both summarise a continuous variable across
a discrete group. Here they are composed into a single figure with `hconcat()`.

```{r}
peng <- na.omit(datasets::penguins)

box <- vplot(peng) |>
  mark_boxplot(x = species, y = flipper_len, fill = species) |>
  labs(title = "Boxplot", y = "flipper (mm)")

vio <- vplot(peng) |>
  mark_violin(x = species, y = flipper_len, fill = species) |>
  labs(title = "Violin", y = NULL)

p <- hconcat(box, vio)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
vg(p, "boxplot-violin")
```

## Horizontal boxes and violins

Swap the axes and the boxes turn on their side. `orientation` is inferred as in
ggplot2: a discrete `y` with a continuous `x` draws horizontal boxes and
violins, which leaves room for long group names. `orientation = "y"` forces it.

```{r}
hbox <- vplot(peng) |>
  mark_boxplot(x = body_mass, y = species, fill = species) |>
  labs(title = "Boxplot", x = "body mass (g)", y = NULL)

hvio <- vplot(peng) |>
  mark_violin(x = body_mass, y = species, fill = species) |>
  labs(title = "Violin", x = "body mass (g)", y = NULL)

p_h <- hconcat(hbox, hvio)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
vg(p_h, "boxplot-violin-horizontal")
```

## Means with confidence intervals

`mark_summary()` collapses each group to a point and a range. With
`fun.data = "mean_cl_normal"` that is the mean and its 95% confidence interval
under a normal approximation, here drawn over the raw observations
(`"mean_se"`, `"mean_sdl"` and `"median_hilow"` are the other built-ins). With
only 7 to 14 cars per group the intervals are wide enough to see.

```{r}
p_sum <- vplot(mtcars) |>
  mark_point(x = factor(cyl), y = mpg, color = factor(cyl), alpha = 0.4,
             position = "jitter") |>
  mark_summary(x = factor(cyl), y = mpg, fun.data = "mean_cl_normal") |>
  labs(title = "Mean fuel economy, 95% confidence interval",
       x = "cylinders", color = "cylinders")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
vg(p_sum, "boxplot-violin-summary")
```
